_note: Player identity over time, keyed on account_id — the only stable key OpenDota exposes. `handles` records the handle a player used AS OF an event, which is the only thing the UI may display for that event. OpenDota's `name` is a CURRENT handle and is stored only as `opendota_current_name`, for drift detection.

_source_types.owner-confirmation: Confirmed directly by the project owner, who watched these events live. A first-class source for this project.

players.note: Changed handle to Quinn after TI8. This is the worked example of why OpenDota's name field cannot be trusted for a historical roster: an automated fill would have labelled a 2018 lineup with a handle he had not yet adopted.
